summary: Short steep kerb on a through road with no parked cars.

best_section.where: East kerb of Clarence Road, south of the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Dense vegetation on the east side, but houses 18-21 m away at both ends.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight into scrub and fence line; no verge or pull-off clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Two-lane through road with a junction at the top; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb in either image, no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Heavy tree cover along the east side; shade most of the day.
